ftbultimine.client_settings.show_overlay: If true, keep FTB Ultimine's original plain-text overlay visible.
ftbultimine.client_settings.toggle.toolt: If true, the Ultimine key works as a toggle instead of needing to be held.
ftbultimine.client_settings.indicator.to: Settings for the custom Ultimine indicator rendered near the crosshair.
ftbultimine.client_settings.indicator.en: If true, show the custom Ultimine indicator.
ftbultimine.client_settings.indicator.sh: Shape Icon
Settings for the shape icon panel.
Show Shape Icon
If true, show the current shape icon.
Shape Icon Position
Base position of the shape icon panel.
Shape Icon X Offset
Horizontal offset for the shape icon panel.
Shape Icon Y Offset
Vertical offset for the shape icon panel.
Shape Icon X Anchor
Horizontal anchor for the shape icon panel: 0 = left, 1 = center, 2 = right.
Shape Icon Y Anchor
Vertical anchor for the shape icon panel: 0 = top, 1 = center, 2 = bottom.
Shape Name
Settings for the current shape name label.
Show Shape Name
Controls when the shape name is visible.
Shape Name Position
Base position of the shape name label.
Shape Name X Offset
Horizontal offset for the shape name label.
Shape Name Y Offset
Vertical offset for the shape name label.
Shape Name X Anchor
Horizontal anchor for the shape name label: 0 = left, 1 = center, 2 = right.
Shape Name Y Anchor
Vertical anchor for the shape name label: 0 = top, 1 = center, 2 = bottom.
ftbultimine.client_settings.indicator.ul: Settings for the status text shown below the indicator.
If true, show the current Ultimine status text.
If true, show a hint below the status text about scrolling to change shape.
Base position of the Ultimine status label.
Horizontal offset for the Ultimine status label.
Vertical offset for the Ultimine status label.
Horizontal anchor for the Ultimine status label: 0 = left, 1 = center, 2 = right.
Vertical anchor for the Ultimine status label: 0 = top, 1 = center, 2 = bottom.
ftbultimine_indicator.hint.change_shape_: Hold %s and scroll to change shape.
